overview: At two the plot was Titus at the Theatre. No name of a part was on the peg. You did not add one. The hired men had the name by this afternoon.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Played, and brought no part-name away.

parties.name: Will Kemp
parties.context: The name is his, from last night. He is not on this plot.

parties.name: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
parties.formal_term: William Blackwage, Ralph Raye, Richard Hoope
parties.context: They had the name by this afternoon.

important_dates.meaning: Titus, no name of a part
